description: Read the creative baseline catalog: everyday situations in which people feel reward and anticipation (dopamine hooks), each with visual, audio and situation cues and guardrails, plus the planning principle and this week's practice theme. Call before planning any creative work, then build at least one hook into the final output and declare it in batch_validate/batch_submit. Filter with group or ids. No generation, quota or GPU job.

ids.description: Filter hooks to the specified catalog IDs.
